title: Delta flight hit by firework while landing at Midway Airport on Fourth of July
summary: A Delta Airlines flight was struck by a firework while landing at Chicago Midway Airport on Independence Day (July 4th), highlighting aviation safety concerns during holiday celebrations with fireworks.
problem_solved: This is a news incident report, not a technical solution - it documents an aviation safety event rather than solving a problem.
why_valuable: Reports on a rare aviation safety incident that could inform future security measures around airports during fireworks-heavy holidays.
